source.author: lucan
source.text: Vadimus in campos steriles, exustaque mundi, Qua nimius Titan, et rarae in fontibus undae, Siccaque letiferis squalent serpentibus arva, Durum iter.
source.text_original: Vadimus in campos steriles, exustaque mundi, / Qua nimius Titan, et rarae in fontibus undae, / Siccaque letiferis squalent serpentibus arva, / Durum iter.
source.text_english: We go into barren plains and the world’s scorched regions, where the sun is too fierce, and the waters in the springs are scarce, and the fields are parched and rough with deadly serpents, a hard journey.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tendite in astra, viri: mea primum regia mundo Iapeti post bella trucis Phlegramque labores imposuit: durum vobis iter et grave caeli institui.
reuse.text_original: 'tendite in astra, viri: mea primum regia mundo / Iapeti post bella trucis Phlegramque labores / imposuit: durum vobis iter et grave caeli / institui.
reuse.text_english: Strive toward the stars, men: my kingdom first imposed on the world, after the wars of savage Iapetus and the labors at Phlegra, a hard and weighty journey to heaven I have established for you.
